title: Tiptap Editor Link Rel & Target Attributes Fix
desc: Rich text editor mein links ke rel aur target attributes ka issue solve kiya: default rel clear kiya aur rel='noopener noreferrer nofollow' ko dropdown options ke sath customize kiya.

title: Newsletter Subscription Setup & SiteGround SMTP
desc: Website par newsletter subscription form banaya, email verification implement ki aur SiteGround SMTP ke sath secure email delivery configure ki.

title: Scholarship Guide Sub-Navbar Options Fix
desc: Scholarship guide ke sub-navbar options ka difference resolve kiya aur clean code maintenance ke liye isolated 'subscribe' branch create ki.

title: Newsletter Broadcasts & News Updates Section
desc: Admin panel mein subscribers ko news updates bhejne ka section banaya, jismein custom heading, message aur website par redirect karne wala CTA button shamil hai.

title: Multi-Select Checkboxes & Selective Emailing
desc: Subscribers table mein multi-select checkboxes aur Select All ka option add kiya taake admin apni marzi ke mutabiq chuninda subscribers ko email send kar sake.

title: Customizable Welcome Email & Topic Tracking
desc: Welcome email customize karne ka admin option banaya aur user subscription source track kiya (e.g. gold, petrol, sports) taake relevant content bheja ja sake.

title: Draft Campaigns & Scheduled Broadcasts
desc: Campaigns draft karne aur future time schedule karne ka feature banaya taake decide kiye gaye waqt par background worker auto-broadcast execute kar sake.

title: Automated Daily Rates Alerts (Gold & Petrol)
desc: Daily rates schedule banaya jaha se subha 9 baje (ya kisi bhi waqt) subscribers ko gold aur petrol ke verified live rates email boxes mein auto-send hote hain.

title: Combined Rates Option for All Subscribers
desc: Admin ke liye toggle add kiya jisse gold ya petrol subscribe karne wale tamam users ko dono categories ke rates ek sath combined send kiye ja sakte hain.

title: Side-by-Side Compact Email Template Design
desc: Email template redesign kiya: bulky boxes ko chota karke modern 2-column side-by-side layout banaya (Left: Petrol & Fuel, Right: Sarafa Gold Market).

title: Custom Action Buttons & Target URLs
desc: Admin panel mein Petrol aur Gold buttons ke labels aur redirect URLs customize karne ka option diya, jo live preview aur email template dono mein bind hain.

title: Mobile-Responsive Email Layout
desc: Responsive CSS add ki taake mobile screens par side-by-side columns squish na hon balki automatically full-width clean stacked cards mein render hon.

title: Fuel Rates Today's Date Sync Fix
desc: PSO sync logic theek kiya taake PSO ke purani announcement date (11 Sep) ke bajaye aaj ki live date (12 Sep) top par record aur display ho.

title: Nightly Rates Auto-Sync (12:15 AM PKT)
desc: Background cron worker banaya jo har raat 12:15 AM par Sarafa Gold aur PSO Petrol dono ko auto-sync karta hai taake subha se pehle fresh rates live hon.

title: Database Schema & Prisma Migrations
desc: Tamam naye models aur schedule settings ki official Prisma migrations banayein aur deploy kiya, database schema ko 100% up to date kar ke commit kiya.
